page.layout: One page, no printed text block. A library stamp sits in the centre, and a faint printer's device (ornamental woodcut) lies below it. The large title lines are mirrored show-through from the reverse side of the leaf.
page.notes: The page is blank apart from show-through and the digitiser's/library material. The large mirrored lines ("IN HISTORIAM / PASSIONIS ET RESVRRECTIONIS DOMINI NOSTRI Iesu Christi", "Excudebat Ioannes le Preux", "M.D.XCI.") are reversed text bleeding through from the other side of the leaf, so they are not transcribed. The oval library stamp ("BIBLIOTHEQUE PUBLIQUE DE GENEVE", shelf mark 39) is omitted. The woodcut device is an engraving, not text.
